## WSFS Management to Hold Meetings with Investors at Piper Sandler’s Financial Services Conference


11/10/2026


Download (opens in new window)


WILMINGTON, Del.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


WSFS Financial Corporation (Nasdaq: WSFS), the parent company of WSFS Bank, will participate at Piper Sandler’s Financial Services Conference.


David Burg, Executive Vice President, Chief Financial Officer, and Jamie Hopkins, Executive Vice President, Chief Wealth Officer, will host discussions with investors on November 17-18, 2026, in Aventura, Florida.


**Presentation Materials:** WSFS will present its current Investor Presentation, which is available on the Investor Relations section of[WSFS’ website](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.wsfsbank.com%2Foverview%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54637130&newsitemid=20261110379333&lan=en-US&anchor=WSFS%26%238217%3B+website&index=1&md5=36418a79403e040b4ead487c2f42f80d) .


**About WSFS Financial Corporation**


WSFS Financial Corporation is a multibillion-dollar financial services company. Its primary subsidiary, WSFS Bank, is the oldest and largest locally headquartered bank and wealth management franchise in the Greater Philadelphia and Delaware region. As of September 30, 2026, WSFS Financial Corporation had $22.1 billion in assets on its balance sheet and $109.5 billion in assets under management and administration. WSFS operates from 115 offices, 87 of which are banking offices, located in Pennsylvania (59), Delaware (38), New Jersey (14), Florida (2), Nevada (1) and Virginia (1) and provides comprehensive financial services including commercial banking, consumer banking, treasury management, and trust and wealth management. Other subsidiaries or divisions include Arrow Land Transfer, Bryn Mawr Trust Advisors, LLC, Bryn Mawr Trust®, The Bryn Mawr Trust Company of Delaware, Cash Connect®, NewLane Finance®, WSFS Wealth® Management, LLC, WSFS Institutional Services®, and WSFS Mortgage®. Serving the Greater Delaware Valley since 1832, WSFS Bank is one of the ten oldest banks in the United States continuously operating under the same name. For more information, please visit[www.wsfsbank.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wsfsbank.com&esheet=54637130&newsitemid=20261110379333&lan=en-US&anchor=www.wsfsbank.com&index=2&md5=2714e9a0dad8598ed8c1d75efafd6a90) .
